text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh... th-thank you very much. So you 
already knew about it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course. To me, you are like... a 
kindred spirit. Let us continue to inspire 
and hone one another going forward.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! ...Hehe. I'm so happy. To have such 
a dazzling Umamusume like you say that to 
me...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm still not good enough yet, but... 
One day, I'll shine... and become the 
dazzling star of the show...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Sion-san. Talking to you reminds me of 
Cheval. So earnest, so hardworking..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Principled, passionate, adorable, such a 
genuinely good girl whose smile warms the 
heart, overflowing with such charm—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You and she are very much alike.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Your birthday present! 
Just congratulatory words alone feel a bit 
lacking, so if you'd like, how about a 
meal with my sisters too—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Far from being bland, it's more than 
enough... Right now, I feel like I'm the 
main character, and I'm just savoring 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, words for the star of the show? Even 
more reason. This is nowhere near enough. 
Please let me spend more time sharing them 
with you over our meal.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even more than this!? U-Uuu...! ...No. 
Standing tall and taking praise is part of 
being the lead star... Understood, I'll do 
it, sir!!
